reason.en: The official summary says Proposition 2 "Requires annual transfer of 1.5% of general fund revenues to state budget stabilization account" and "Allows limited use of funds in case of emergency or if there is a state budget deficit."

sourceTitle.en: Official Voter Information Guide, November 4, 2014 General Election: Proposition 2, Official Title and Summary

summary.en: Required the state to move 1.5% of General Fund revenues each year, plus some capital gains tax revenues, into a budget stabilization account, with half used to repay state debts and the rest usable only in an emergency or a budget deficit.

title.en: State Budget. Budget Stabilization Account. Legislative Constitutional Amendment.
